title: Production readiness and security
label: Reference architecture: how I approach this
summary: A model-backed feature ships only after it is tested, secured and observable.

layers.name: Build
layers.note: Prompts, retrieval and tools versioned like any other code.

layers.name: Test and evaluate
layers.note: Fixed test sets for answers, tool calls and failure cases.

layers.name: Secure
layers.note: Secrets out of code, least-privilege access, input and output checks.

layers.name: Release
layers.note: Staged rollout with a way back.

layers.name: Operate
layers.note: Monitoring, cost and quality review after release.

textAlternative: Five stages from left to right. Build, then test and evaluate, then secure, then release, then operate. Findings from operating feed back into build.
